proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'magic_item' kind. The taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom but there is no MagicItemRecord type or any MagicItemMechanics family in types.ts. No honest encoding is possible without this top-level record shape.

proposed_widenings.name: DcSource: fixed_dc
proposed_widenings.justification: The item provides spells at a fixed save DC of 17 that is independent of the wielder's spellcasting ability. Existing DcSource variants are caster_spell_save_dc and weapon_attack_dc — neither represents a hardcoded DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it … you can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 17)

proposed_widenings.name: waive_concentration
proposed_widenings.justification: Detect Thoughts normally requires concentration, but the item explicitly removes that requirement for the copy it grants. No existing effect atom represents removing a spell's concentration requirement.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration

proposed_widenings.name: spell_dependency_lifecycle
proposed_widenings.justification: The Detect Thoughts granted by the item ends when Scrying ends — a cross-spell lifecycle dependency that is not modeled by existing lifecycle atoms (concentrate, persist, expire, dismiss). The Detect Thoughts is not concentration but is still coupled to the outer spell's termination.
proposed_widenings.evidence: it ends if the Scrying spell ends

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment: sensor
proposed_widenings.justification: Detect Thoughts targets creatures within 30 feet of the Scrying sensor, not within 30 feet of the caster. No existing Attachment variant represents 'range from a remote sensor created by another active spell'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: targeting creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor

proposed_widenings.name: magic_item grant_spell_access mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core behavior is granting access to two spells (Scrying and Detect Thoughts) with modified parameters. There is no mechanics family for item-granted spell access with per-spell parameter overrides (fixed DC, waived concentration, sensor-based range, lifecycle coupling).
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) … you can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 17) … You don't need to concentrate … it ends if the Scrying spell ends

notes: Encoding is blocked at the record level: UnitRecord has no 'magic_item' kind. Even if that were added, four additional surface/atom widenings would remain: fixed-DC DcSource variant, waive_concentration effect atom, cross-spell lifecycle dependency, and sensor-relative Attachment variant. All four are forced independently by the rule text.
